messages:
Aisha: Heads-up: deploy window tonight for model-routing. Window 01:30-03:30 UTC. Plan: roll v3.1.0, pin traffic for canary to v3.0.7, enable feature flag model_route_v3 at tiny percent and ramp. @deploy-bot schedule for 01:30?

deploy-bot: scheduled 01:30 UTC. Canary plan: global 0.5% -> 2% -> 8% (25m). EU conservative: 0.5 -> 1 -> 2 -> 5 -> 8 with 5m holds. Auto-rollback: errors >2.5% OR p99 >2.5x baseline on 2 samples. Owners: Aisha (lead), Ravi (ops), Tom (platform).

Ravi: added checklist to release notes. Quick q: explicit fallback pin or rely on toggle only?

Aisha: add both. Fallback pin = v3.0.6. Toggle off is immediate, pin helps routing consistency.

Tom: will attach script in deploy docs: ./admin pin-service model-routing v3.0.6 --reason "rollback from v3.1.0" (admin token req).

Lena: observability note: enable synthetic probes against canary + billing delta monitor. New path increases per-token work.

deploy-bot: Canary started 01:30 UTC. EU on conservative schedule. Monitors: perf-dash, synth, error-alerts, billing-delta.

Ravi: watching errors and latency, first windows stable.

deploy-bot: global -> 2% at +7m; EU -> 1% at +7m. No triggers.

Lena: slight p99 rise for long sequences in eu-central (~30% higher for >512 tokens). Not yet alerting but recommend slow EU ramp by 10m.

Aisha: agree. Tom, hold EU progression by 10m?

Tom: holding EU ramp, noted in thread.

deploy-bot: EU hold applied. Global on schedule.

Ravi: small error surge in auth-proxy coincident with EU ramp attempt  investigating; if errors cross 2.5% auto-rollback will trigger.

Lena: auth-proxy mitigation deployed, metrics stabilizing. No rollback.

deploy-bot: global -> 8% at +25m. EU finished conservative ramp to 8% after holds. No auto-rollback. Canary complete. Scheduled unpin at 04:00 UTC.

Aisha: post-canary actions: run evals on top 200 prompts, check cost delta 2h, confirm no SLO regressions in 1h before unpin. Ravi 0-1h, Tom 1-2h.

Ravi: I'll own 0-1h monitoring; will escalate if p99 >1.8x baseline or errors >1.5%.

Tom: I'll run unpin at 04:00 if green: ./admin unpin-service model-routing v3.1.0 --confirm. Also update changelog.

Lena: add reason for temporary pin in changelog for audit.

Aisha: rollback steps if needed: 1) /ff toggle model_route_v3 off --immediate 2) admin pin to v3.0.6 3) create incident and page oncall.

Tom: ack.

deploy-bot: Cleanup scheduled: unpin at 04:00 UTC; will report final status.

Aisha: closing thread  nice job. Ping here if urgent. :rocket:
